text:
incident-bot: PAGER: inferpool-eu-west-2a kubelet status=NotReady count=3 since=4398765200 severity=page
elaine: acked, oncall here. seeing spike on customer-facing gen-2 endpoints, increased tail latency and a few 502s. pulling logs now.
jamal: I see the same in dashboard — pod restarts + kubelet restarts on two nodes (ip: 10.2.14.5, 10.2.14.6). error in dmesg points to GPU driver churn and oom events.
ryan: copying some logs, here's kubelet journal from 10.2.14.5:
```
Mar 10 12:03:25 kubelet[1234]: E0310 12:03:25 ... eviction manager: memory pressure: node allocatable exhausted
Mar 10 12:03:26 kubelet[1234]: E0310 12:03:26 container runtime: failed to start container: Error response from daemon: write /dev/nvidia0: no space left on device
Mar 10 12:03:27 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 9876 (runtime) score 1000
```
elaine: that matches the inference runtime OOM trace we saw. probable continuous batching + big prefix workloads triggered KV cache growth, then driver churn.
luis: cc @maya-product — any customer eval runs in eu-west right now?
maya-product: not aware of scheduled eval jobs, but a customer reported flaky completions ~12:05. product page shows elevated lat for /v1/chat/generate.
jamal: I've flagged two nodes and cordoned them: 
```
kubectl cordon node-eu-a-05
kubectl cordon node-eu-a-06
```
elaine: good. I'm going to drain one of them (non-evict-critical) to move pods off and see if pressure eases. running: 
```
kubectl drain node-eu-a-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```
ryan: note — autoscaler might try to replace. please set scale down disabled for this ASG until we confirm.
jamal: set ASG scale protection on group inferpool-eu-a.
elaine: while drain runs, I'm restarting the kubelet on node-eu-a-06 (remote systemd restart) to clear any driver/heartbeat stuck state. command: 
```
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
```
deploy-bot: kubelet restart job queued on node-eu-a-06 by elaine.
ryan: after the kubelet restart, node came back NotReady -> Ready, but pods on that node are CrashLoopBackoff with cuda error: 
```
E tensorflow: CudaDriverError: failed to initialize NVML: unknown error
```
elainE: (typo) — elaine: we should fallback models to cpu-compatible variants for the short term if the GPU pool is unstable. patching routing policy now.
jamal: creating a temporary routing policy override: route infer-gen2 -> infer-gen2-cpu for eu-west region with weight=60, fallback to gen2-gpu for 40. applying: 
```
redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west --model gen2 --fallback gen2-cpu --weight 60
```
maya-product: notifying affected customers via status page note (draft): "We are investigating increased latency and intermittent errors for inference in EU. Mitigations in progress."
ricardo: (reacts) :+1:
luis: checking metric trend — token-per-second dropped 22% for eu-west, tail latency p99 jumped from 120ms to 1.2s. error budget on the gen2 route is burning.
jamal: one of the nodes reported repeated OOMKilled containers due to pinned KV cache growth. I'll add a lower max-kv-cache-size to the model shim for this pool and push a hotfix config: 
```
# set env for runtime
KV_CACHE_MAX_BYTES=2147483648
```
elaine: go for the hotfix, but keep low disruption. also open a reproducible trace capture for the runtime team.
ryan: I'm preparing a temporary scaling bump on Dedicated capacity to absorb traffic while we stabilize; requesting +4 GPUs in eu-west ASG.
jamal: autoscaler accepts scale request, rolling up new nodes (expected join in ~4m).
maya-product: status page updated. adding note: "We have rerouted a portion of EU traffic to CPU-backed instances and are adding capacity; ETA stabilization ~15m."
elaine: drain completed on node-eu-a-05, pods moved successfully. memory pressure reduced per node-exporter. kubelet on node-eu-a-06 restarted and node is Ready.
jamal: pushing the KV_CACHE_MAX_BYTES change to the runtime config via k8s configmap patch: 
```
kubectl patch configmap runtime-config -n infer --patch '{"data":{"KV_CACHE_MAX_BYTES":"2147483648"}}'
```
deploy-bot: configmap runtime-config patched by jamal. rolling restart of runtime-deployment initiated.
ryan: new nodes are joining, gpu drivers installing; driver installs sometimes cause brief taints, monitoring.
luis: after the routing override and config patch, errors dropped 75% and p99 is trending back toward baseline. still seeing occasional cuda init fails on a small fraction of pods.
elaine: recommend we keep the routing override and scale bump for 30 minutes, then gradually revert. also want a post-incident task to investigate KV cache eviction policy and large-prefix workloads.
maya-product: creating an incident ticket and will coordinate customer follow-up. tagging support to compile customer-facing RCA later.
jamal: note for SRE runbook: add step to check driver nvml logs and oom_kill summaries before automatic cordon.
elaine: handing off to night oncall in 40m; @ryan please keep an eye on eu-west and escalate if nodes show repeated kubelet restarts.
ryan: will monitor. setting alert mute windows for non-critical noise.
maya-product: assigning follow-ups: 
- Investigate root cause of OOM growth (jamal)
- Improve KV cache eviction + caps (luis)
- Add autoscale safety net when many nodes cordoned (ryan)
- Customer comms and RCA (maya-product)

elaine: thanks team. final status update in 20m: mitigation holding, degraded but progressing to healthy.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigating impact, pages suppressed.
ryan: we should add a simple healthcheck test that tries a small inference on every newly provisioned GPU node to validate NVML before routing traffic. filing a ticket.
jamal: filed GH issue #4821 "gpu-node-nvml-smokecheck" with patch suggestion.
elaine: copy. good job everyone. :clap:
maya-product: closing thread now, will reopen if regression.
